llm.summary: This is a documentation-writing helper with no executable code or hidden security-sensitive behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The skill consistently describes generating and remediating documentation, style cleanup, docstring/comment edits, and quality checks; those capabilities match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger terms are broad enough to activate on ordinary writing requests, but the runtime instructions stay focused on documentation work and require user approval for final output or major changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown skill and module files, with no install scripts, hooks, binaries, or automatic execution paths in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The referenced reads and commands are limited to style profiles, target documents, simple grep checks, and related writing-quality skills; no credential, session, network, or broad local indexing behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, destructive behavior, or hidden mutation authority is shown; editing authority is limited to user-directed documentation remediation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you want an agent to help draft or clean up documentation. Be aware it may trigger on broad writing-related prompts, so review proposed edits before accepting them, especially for large rewrites.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad triggers are a real scope-hygiene note, but they fit a writing/documentation helper and do not create a material security concern without hidden actions or high-impact authority.
